name: Deadly Workshop

stealth.note: (expert) to notice the blades embedded in the chains and the complex system of pulleys connecting them

description: Swinging bladed chains whip through the entire workshop.
disable: DC 20 Thievery check (expert) on the control panel on the raised platform deactivates the trap.
reset: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.
routine: (1 action) The trap swings one slashing blade against every creature in the workshop as 1 action. The entire workshop is treated as difficult terrain because of the sheer number of slashing chains. This trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.

hp.note: Hardness 14 BT 25. to destroy the chains and disable the trap

offensiveAbilities.name: Swinging Blades
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Two or more creatures enter the workshop or end their turn in the workshop

Effect The trap makes a slashing blade Strike against the triggering creatures, then rolls initiative.

offensiveAbilities.name: No MAP
offensiveAbilities.description: This trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.
